questions.q: Which section of RA 9266 provides the 'Definition of Terms,' including critical architectural roles like the Architect of Record and Architect-in-Charge of Construction?
questions.n: Section 3 is the comprehensive list of definitions for terms used throughout the Act.

questions.q: Under which Article can you find the provisions regarding the 'Practice of Architecture,' specifically covering Section 25 to Section 39?
questions.n: Article 4 encompasses the rules, prohibitions, and requirements for the actual practice of the profession.

questions.q: If you are looking for the 'Qualifications of Members' of the Professional Regulatory Board of Architecture, which section should you refer to?
questions.n: Section 5 details the requirements such as being a resident, a degree holder, and having 10 years of practice.

questions.q: According to RA 9266, which section outlines the 'Subjects for Examination' for aspiring architects?
questions.n: Section 14 specifies the technical areas covered in the licensure exam.

questions.q: The rules regarding the 'Ownership of Plans, Specifications and other Contract Documents' are found in which section?
questions.n: Section 33 explicitly protects the architect's ownership and intellectual property of their work.

questions.q: Which section of RA 9266 establishes the 'Terms of Office' for the PRBOA Chairman and members?
questions.n: Section 6 defines the 3-year term and the rules for re-appointment.

questions.q: Provisions concerning 'Continuing Professional Development (CPD)' are located in which section?
questions.n: Section 28 mandates the CPD program for all registered architects.

questions.q: Which section addresses the 'Limitation to the Registration of a Firm, Company, Partnership, Corporation or Association'?
questions.n: Section 37 sets the 75% ownership rule and registration requirements for firms.

questions.q: Article 5: Final Provisions includes 'Section 45', which is known as the:
questions.n: Section 45 ensures that if one part of the Act is invalid, the rest remains in effect.

questions.q: Which section identifies the grounds for 'Suspension and Revocation of Certificates of Registration'?
questions.n: Section 23 details the disciplinary actions that can lead to losing one's license.

questions.q: Which section of RA 9266 officially establishes the 'Short Title' of the Act?
questions.n: The first section of any Republic Act typically provides the name by which the law shall be known.

questions.q: In the Definition of Terms (Section 3), what refers to the 'conceptualization of the form and structure of a building'?
questions.n: This term specifically deals with the act of conceiving the building's form and structural logic.

questions.q: The PRBOA is composed of a Chairman and how many members?
questions.n: Section 4 specifies a total of three people: one Chairman and two members.

questions.q: Under Section 5, how many years of active practice must a candidate for the PRBOA have?
questions.n: The Act requires a decade of experience to ensure the member has deep professional maturity.

questions.q: Which section deals with the 'Compensation and Allowances of the Board'?
questions.n: Section 10 outlines how Board members are paid for their services.

questions.q: Article 3 (Examination, Licensure and Registration) begins with which section?
questions.n: Section 12 mandates that all applicants must undergo a licensure examination.

questions.q: Which section requires the PRBOA to submit an 'Annual Report' to the Commission?
questions.n: This section ensures accountability by requiring a yearly summary of activities.

questions.q: Under Section 6, what is the maximum number of years a Chairman can serve if they are re-appointed for a full term after their initial term?
questions.n: With a 3-year initial term and one re-appointment of 3 years, the total is 6.

questions.q: Which section lists the requirements to apply for the licensure examination, such as being a Filipino citizen?
questions.n: Section 13 provides the checklist of criteria an applicant must meet.

questions.q: Section 15 deals with the 'Rating in the Licensure Examination.' What is the weighted general average required to pass?
questions.n: The standard set by Section 15 is a general average of 70% with no grade below 50% in any subject.

questions.q: Which section requires every registrant to take an 'Oath' before practicing?
questions.n: The Oath is a mandatory ceremony before the issuance of the Certificate of Registration.

questions.q: Section 19 involves the 'Roster of Architects.' Who is responsible for maintaining this list?
questions.n: The Professional Regulatory Board of Architecture is tasked with keeping the official record of names.

questions.q: Which section describes the 'Seal, Issuance and Use of Seal' for a licensed architect?
questions.n: Section 20 mandates the use of a seal on all architectural documents.

questions.q: Section 21 requires the architect to indicate which of the following on all professional documents?
questions.n: The license number and its expiration (PTR) must be displayed to prove authority.

questions.q: Grounds for 'Refusal to Issue Certificate of Registration' are found in which section?
questions.n: This section lists disqualifiers like immoral conduct or conviction of a crime.

questions.q: Under Section 24, how many years must pass before a revoked certificate can be re-issued?
questions.n: The Act generally allows for a petition for re-issuance after a 2-year period of revocation.

questions.q: Which section explicitly prohibits the practice of architecture by non-registered persons and defines the 'Penal Clause'?
questions.n: Section 29 sets the fines and imprisonment terms for illegal practice.

questions.q: Section 32 deals with the 'Signing and Sealing of Architectural Plans.' Who is the only professional allowed to sign architectural documents?
questions.n: The law is clear that architectural plans are the exclusive domain of licensed architects.

questions.q: Section 35 dictates that 'Positions in Government' requiring architectural skills must be filled by registered architects. Which Article is this in?
questions.n: This section falls within the Practice of Architecture (Section 25 to 39).

questions.q: Which section covers the 'Collection of Professional Fees'?
questions.n: Section 36 provides the legal basis for architects to charge and collect fees.

questions.q: Under Section 37, what is the minimum percentage of ownership by registered architects required for a partnership or corporation?
questions.n: The law requires at least three-fourths of the owners to be licensed architects.

questions.q: Section 38: Coverage of Temporary Special Permits applies to whom?
questions.n: Foreign architects can practice under specific conditions with a temporary permit.

questions.q: Which section covers the 'Integration of the Architecture Profession' into one accredited organization?
questions.n: Section 40 mandates the creation of the IAPOA.

questions.q: The 'Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR)' of RA 9266 are described in which section?
questions.n: Section 41 tasks the Board with creating the specific rules to execute the law.

questions.q: Which section states that 'This Act shall not affect or prevent the practice of any other legally recognized profession'?
questions.n: Section 43 protects the scope of other professions like engineering or interior design.

questions.q: Section 46 is known as the 'Repealing Clause.' What does this clause do?
o: Ensures the law stays in effect forever
Invalidates previous laws that conflict with RA 9266
questions.n: It officially cancels older laws (like portions of RA 545) that are inconsistent with the new Act.

questions.q: Section 47: 'Effectivity' states the law takes effect 15 days after publication. In which Article is this found?
questions.n: Article 5 contains the final administrative legalities and the effectivity clause.

questions.q: Under Section 3, who is the architect 'who is directly and professionally responsible and liable for the construction supervision'?
questions.n: This specific role is tied to site presence and construction management.

questions.q: Which section of Article 2 outlines the 'Powers and Functions of the Board'?
questions.n: Section 7 empowers the Board to issue rules, administer oaths, and investigate violations.

questions.q: If a Board member is convicted of a crime involving moral turpitude, which section allows for their 'Suspension or Removal'?
questions.n: Section 9 provides the legal mechanism to remove a sitting Board member.

questions.q: Section 18 covers the 'Issuance of Certificates of Registration.' What other card is issued alongside this certificate?
questions.n: The PIC is the smaller, portable ID card that contains the license number and expiry date.

questions.q: Section 26, 'Vested Rights,' protects which group of people?
o: Architects registered under previous laws like RA 545
questions.n: This section ensures that previously licensed architects stay licensed under the new Act.

questions.q: Under Section 3, 'Authorship' refers to the ownership and rights over what?
o: The plans, specifications, and other contract documents
questions.n: Authorship refers to the intellectual property and creation of the design documents.

questions.q: Which section prohibits any person from using the title 'Architect' unless they are duly registered?
questions.n: This specific section is a direct prohibition against the illegal use of the professional title.

questions.q: Section 39 requires a foreign national practicing under a temporary permit to have what type of protection?
questions.n: Insurance is required to cover potential damages or professional errors during their local practice.

questions.q: What does Section 45, the 'Separability Clause,' ensure in the event of a legal challenge?
o: Only the invalid part is voided, leaving the rest in effect
questions.n: It 'separates' the valid parts from any part declared unconstitutional.

questions.q: Under Section 3, 'Service Agreement' refers to a contract between which two parties?
questions.n: The service agreement defines the professional relationship and scope for the owner/client.

questions.q: Which section requires the 'Roster of Architects' to be updated annually?
questions.n: Section 19 specifically mandates the maintenance and public availability of the updated list of architects.

questions.q: Section 8 describes the 'Administrative Supervision' of the Board. Who has this supervisory power?
o: Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH)
questions.n: The PRC is the umbrella agency that supervises all professional regulatory boards.

questions.q: Which section details the 'Subjects for Examination,' including Urban Design and Architectural Design?
questions.n: Section 14 lists the specific technical domains you will be tested on during the exam.

questions.q: According to Section 4, how is the Chairman of the Board appointed?
o: Appointed by the President of the Philippines
questions.n: All Board members, including the Chairman, are presidential appointees.

questions.q: Which section handles the 'Refusal to Issue Certificate of Registration' for an applicant who passed the exam?
questions.n: This section explains that even if you pass, specific legal or moral issues can prevent licensure.

questions.q: Section 31: 'Liability of Representative of Non-registered Persons' focuses on which scenario?
o: Acting as a middleman or agent for an unlicensed practitioner
Opening a firm with a civil engineer
questions.n: This section holds people liable if they represent someone practicing without a license.

questions.q: Section 42: 'Appropriations' refers to what?
o: Government funding for the implementation of the Act
The collection of tax from architects
questions.n: It ensures there is a budget allocated for the Board and the Commission's tasks.

questions.q: Section 27: 'Reciprocity Requirements' allows foreign architects to practice if:
o: Their home country allows Filipino architects to practice there
questions.n: Reciprocity means a 'two-way street' between the Philippines and the other country.

questions.q: Section 3: 'Integrated and Accredited Professional Organization' refers specifically to which acronym in the Philippines?
questions.n: This is the official legal term used in Section 3 to define the single accredited body.

questions.q: Which section mandates that 'Registration of Architects Required' is the only way to legally practice?
questions.n: This is the 'entry' section for Article 4, making registration the fundamental requirement for practice.

questions.q: Section 10: 'Compensation and Allowances' ensures Board members are paid based on what standard?
o: A percentage of all exam fees
questions.n: Their pay is standardized according to the government's budget and salary laws.

questions.q: Article 1 is titled 'General Provisions.' Which sections does it encompass?
questions.n: Article 1 contains the title, policy, and definitions.

questions.q: Section 44: 'Enforcement of the Act' tasks which specific group with assisting the Board in legal actions?
questions.n: Legal enforcement and prosecution support come from the government's justice department.

questions.q: Which specific Article of RA 9266 is dedicated to 'Examination, Licensure and Registration'?
questions.n: Article 3 covers the entire process from exam qualifications to the issuance of certificates.

questions.q: Which section serves as the 'Statement of Policy,' declaring the state's intent to provide a licensure program for architects?
questions.n: Section 2 outlines the goals and underlying policies the state aims to uphold through this law.

questions.q: In Section 3, who is defined as the architect 'professionally and academically qualified' and registered under this Act?
questions.n: This is the primary definition for a person who has fulfilled all legal requirements to practice.

questions.q: Under Section 4, the Chairman and two members of the Board are collectively known as what?
questions.n: This stands for the Professional Regulatory Board of Architecture.

questions.q: Which section governs the 'Subjects for Examination,' ensuring you know exactly what topics will be tested?
questions.n: Section 14 details the specific subjects and technical areas of the board exam.

questions.q: According to Section 6, how long is the term of office for a member of the Board?
questions.n: The Act specifies a 3-year term for each member upon appointment.

questions.q: Which section requires you to have a 'Good Moral Character' as a qualification for the examination?
questions.n: Section 13 lists being of good moral character as a prerequisite for exam eligibility.

questions.q: Section 17 requires the 'Oath.' Who must take this oath?
o: All successful candidates in the examination
questions.n: Every person who passes the exam must take the oath before they can officially practice.

questions.q: Which section provides the 'Roster of Architects' which lists all validly registered professionals?
questions.n: Section 19 mandates that a list of all registered architects be kept and updated.

questions.q: Under Section 20, an architect's seal must be used on which documents?
o: All plans, specifications, and contract documents
Only on the contract with the client
questions.n: The law requires the seal on all official architectural documents to signify professional liability.

questions.q: Which section prohibits a non-registered person from performing architectural services?
questions.n: Section 30 lists the specific acts that are forbidden for those without a license.

questions.q: What is the official title of Section 45 in Article 5?
questions.n: Section 45 ensures that if any part of the act is found invalid, the rest remains in force.

questions.q: In Article 2, which section allows for the 'Suspension and Removal' of Board members?
questions.n: Section 9 specifies the grounds and process for removing a board member from office.

questions.q: Section 21 requires you to show your license info on documents. What does 'PTR' stand for in this context?
questions.n: The PTR must be paid annually and the receipt number displayed alongside your license number.

questions.q: Which section of RA 9266 establishes 'Authorship' and the ownership of your intellectual work?
questions.n: Section 33 explicitly states that plans and specs remain the property of the architect.

questions.q: Section 28 covers 'CPD.' What does the first 'C' stand for?
questions.n: Continuing Professional Development ensures architects keep learning throughout their careers.

questions.q: Under Section 37, a sole proprietorship must register with which agency to use a trade name?
questions.n: The Department of Trade and Industry handles business names for individual owners.

questions.q: Which section contains the 'Effectivity' clause, telling us when RA 9266 officially became law?
questions.n: Section 47 is the very last section, marking the end and start of the law.

questions.q: Section 25 mandates that 'Registration' is required. Which article does this start?
questions.n: Article 4 begins with Section 25, setting the stage for the Practice of Architecture.

questions.q: Which section covers the 'Enforcement of the Act,' ensuring that violations are prosecuted?
questions.n: Section 44 provides the mandate for officials to enforce the provisions of RA 9266.
